question: Topiramate is a first-line preventive agent for migraine and is particularly useful in overweight patients or those in whom beta-blockers are contraindicated.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is TRUE. Topiramate (along with propranolol, amitriptyline, valproate, and candesartan) is a first-line migraine preventive agent. It has the added advantage of weight loss as a side effect, making it preferable in overweight patients or when propranolol is contraindicated.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Topiramate is a well-established first-line migraine preventive. Its side-effect profile — anorexia and weight loss — makes it particularly suitable for overweight patients or when propranolol is contraindicated (e.g., asthma, bradycardia). Dose: start 25 mg/day, titrate to 50–100 mg/day. Note: teratogenic — avoid in women planning pregnancy.
